ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with localized high-intensity (white) clusters at the lateral margins; estimated macro-ratio is approximately 12:1 low-to-high intensity.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottling concentrated on the distal portion of the left lobe (approximate coordinates relative to lobe: outer 15%); scattered white punctate spots (1-5 pixel diameter) distributed across the central and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression at approximately 65 degrees; depth is deep relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 5-15 pixels from the mean edge boundary; serration is most jagged at the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the lateral edges transitioning to a concave-dominant sweep towards the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast tan/white pixel groups (barnacle colonies) localized heavily along the entire trailing edge and lateral tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct white, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the left lobe surface, oriented diagonally towards the notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral infestation of barnacle colonies resulting in a physically altered, jagged trailing edge profile; multiple linear rake marks on the left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of active water shedding/spray pixels near the fluke base at the water-line interface.
